text: Grid Code compliance and reactive capability (ALP-EPC-00000-EL-STU-0006): steady-state and dynamic simulation of the power island in the grid model of the TSO (frequency response, voltage control, fault ride-through, reactive capability at the generator and at the connection point per ER-04.08, PSS tuning, stability and house-load transition of ER-04.09), used as basis for the Grid Code tests of ER-16.03.
